It can also be seen as a name for someone who is a layman, someone who is knowledgeable about a particular subject but not a professional or expert in that field.

The name Grindlay has since spread beyond Scotland, thanks to emigration, but its connection to Scotland and its associations with hard work and determination remain intact.
